- [GitHub Actions features overview](https://github.com/features/actions)
- [r-lib/actions repository](https://github.com/r-lib/actions) - R-specific actions and example workflows
- [R Packages book: Continuous Integration](https://r-pkgs.org/software-development-practices.html#sec-sw-dev-practices-ci)
- [GitHub Actions documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions)
- [Where to find help with r-lib/actions](https://github.com/r-lib/actions#where-to-find-help)
- [r-ci: Easy and portable CI for R packages](https://eddelbuettel.github.io/r-ci/) -
  a portable shell script by Dirk Eddelbuettel
  for running R package CI across GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, CircleCI, and Docker
- [r-codeberg migration guide](https://codeberg.org/r-codeberg/migration-guide) -
  step-by-step tutorial on porting R package development,
  documentation, and CI workflows from GitHub to Codeberg
- [Woodpecker CI](https://woodpecker-ci.org/) -
  community-driven, container-based continuous integration system
  that integrates with Codeberg, Forgejo, and Gitea for R package checks
- [GitHub Status](https://www.githubstatus.com/) - real-time status of GitHub services
